hypotheses.text: If Kofi Asante-Rhys (LB) had been 1 m closer to Felix Ondo, the shot would have been less likely to succeed — closer pressure from the left-back could have reduced Ondo’s space/time and prevented the goal.
If Mateo Brann (CF) had been 5 m closer to Felix Ondo, the striker’s positioning and blocking of the shooting lane could have disrupted the attempt and reduced the chance of a goal.
